name: Polskie przeboje wszech czasów
author: Beatify Team
description: The all-time-greatest Polish hits, 1966–2023 — from the 1960s big-beat era (Czerwone Gitary, Niemen) through the 1970s and 1980s classics to contemporary artists. Rebuilt from the declared Spotify source after the previous file was found to contain the tracks of Polski Rock (#1902); 59 tracks remain after removing overlaps with Polski Rock and Polskie hity radiowe.
